nodes.label: Dynamic learning campus
nodes.rationale: Academic names, progress, milestones and recommended mission are HTML populated by API data rather than embedded in the illustration.

nodes.label: FastAPI on Render with Supabase session pooler
nodes.norm_label: fastapi on render with supabase session pooler
nodes.rationale: One persistent FastAPI service serves API and frontend; PostgreSQL uses SSL session pooling for IPv4 rather than exposing Supabase keys in the browser.

nodes.label: Gmail password recovery
nodes.rationale: Random reset tokens are stored as SHA256 hashes, expire and are single-use; neutral responses and rate limiting reduce account enumeration and abuse.

nodes.label: HttpOnly JWT session and user ownership
nodes.norm_label: httponly jwt session and user ownership
nodes.rationale: The browser never reads or persists JWT; owned subjects and joined tasks are scoped to the authenticated user, with inaccessible resources returning 404.

nodes.label: Cross-view data:changed refresh
nodes.rationale: Weekly agenda reuses authenticated task endpoints and PATCH status; data:changed keeps dashboard, tasks and agenda coherent without new tables.

nodes.label: Deterministic task priority ranking
nodes.rationale: Urgency, subject progress, due date and title select a pending task with a Portuguese explanation, without generative AI or schema changes.

nodes.label: Google Classroom read-only import
nodes.rationale: Optional OAuth imports courses and dated activities manually; encrypted refresh tokens use a private PostgreSQL schema and disconnect preserves imported academic records.

nodes.label: EDU IA contextual Gemini tutor
nodes.rationale: The server holds the Gemini key and sends task, subject and recent conversation context; demonstration quotas limit usage.

nodes.label: Portable Windows runtime
nodes.rationale: CMD launchers resolve their own directory, bootstrap per-user Python and portable PostgreSQL, and use a virtual drive for accented paths without administrator access.

nodes.label: Google Classroom implementation plan
nodes.rationale: OAuth PKCE, encrypted refresh tokens, private links, injectable gateway and atomic idempotent synchronization.

nodes.label: OpenSpec baseline implementation plan
nodes.rationale: Record delivered FastAPI behavior as canonical capabilities while preserving historical designs.

nodes.label: Weekly agenda design
nodes.rationale: Reuse authenticated task endpoints and filter seven visible days to avoid new tables, migrations or dependencies.

nodes.label: Deterministic study recommendation
nodes.rationale: Recommend one incomplete task by overdue, today, next three days, lowest subject progress, due date and title, with an explanation.

nodes.label: Google Classroom read-only integration design
nodes.rationale: Private schema, RLS and encrypted refresh tokens explicitly isolate secrets instead of relying on variable Supabase Data API defaults.

nodes.label: EDU IA contextual tutor proposal
nodes.rationale: Keep students within EduTrack for academic questions using backend Gemini and private conversations.

nodes.label: EDU IA completed implementation checklist
nodes.rationale: Private persistence, Gemini client, authenticated routes, limits, Campus chat and validation are checked complete.

nodes.label: OpenSpec proposed change workflow
nodes.rationale: Each proposal declares scope, security impact and acceptance criteria before changing accepted behavior.

nodes.label: EduTrack project context
nodes.rationale: FastAPI app/main.py is authoritative; root Streamlit app.py is legacy. Campus maps subjects to buildings and tasks to missions.

nodes.label: Canonical OpenSpec product rules
nodes.rationale: Current accepted requirements supplement historical design rationale; accepted changes merge into canonical specs and archive proposals.

nodes.label: Academic organization capability
nodes.rationale: Owner-scoped subject and task CRUD, completion progress, Classroom origin badges and safe external links.

nodes.label: Authentication and account capability
nodes.rationale: Argon2 passwords, individual sessions, neutral recovery responses and Gmail temporary reset links protect accounts.

nodes.label: Campus dashboard capability
nodes.rationale: Campus visualizes real user progress, deterministic next action and first-subject then first-task onboarding.

nodes.label: Windows delivery and portability capability
nodes.rationale: Project-relative CMD launchers avoid admin rights and permanent policy changes; port conflict checks and /api/version diagnose stale applications.

nodes.label: EDU IA tutor capability
nodes.rationale: Private contextual conversation history uses owned academic context and recent messages; optional Gemini defaults to five questions per minute and fifty per day.

nodes.label: Google Classroom integration capability
nodes.rationale: Optional read-only manual sync imports active courses and published dated work without duplicates; disconnect retains academic records.

nodes.label: Weekly agenda and study plan capability
nodes.norm_label: weekly agenda and study plan capability
nodes.rationale: Monday-to-Sunday navigation, shared status updates, adaptive completion summary, selected-day mission and Campus progress.
